issuing_agency.description: The federal agency that issued the authority documents, from the letterhead, e.g. 'Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration'

issuing_office.description: The office named under the signature, e.g. 'Office of Registration'

authority_documents.description: One entry per authority document (certificate, permit or license) in the batch, in page order. Each document is one page.

service_date.description: The date printed under SERVICE DATE at the top right, as printed, e.g. 'February 16, 2023'

document_type.description: The kind of authority document, from the heading above the docket number

docket_number.description: The MC docket number exactly as printed under the heading, including the MC- prefix and the type suffix, e.g. 'MC-1179808-C'

usdot_number.description: The digits of the U.S. DOT number printed on the line 'U.S. DOT No.', without the label

carrier_name.description: The legal name of the authority holder, as printed under the U.S. DOT number

dba_name.description: The trade name after 'D/B/A', without the 'D/B/A' prefix; null when none is printed

city.description: The holder's city from the 'CITY, ST' line under the name

state.description: The holder's two-letter state or province code from the 'CITY, ST' line

carrier_type.description: The kind of operation the document authorizes, from the bold text in the first paragraph, e.g. 'common carrier', 'contract carrier' or 'broker'

commodity_scope.description: What may be transported or arranged, from the bold text after the carrier type, e.g. 'property (except household goods)'

service_condition.description: Any additional condition printed as its own sentence after the compliance paragraph, e.g. a requirement to serve under continuing agreements; null when none is printed

signing_official.description: The name and title printed under the signature, e.g. 'Jeffrey L. Secrist, Division Chief'

form_code.description: The short code printed at the bottom right of the page, e.g. 'CMO' or 'PMO'
